My name is Hunter Carroll, and I am a Ph.D. student in Applied Mathematics at the University of Colorado Denver.


I am currently pursuing my Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics at the University of Colorado Denver, with research interests spanning applied analysis, linear algebra, and computational methods.



I am completing a data science internship at Donor Alliance, an organ and tissue donation organization, where I work on clinical NLP pipelines and predictive modeling for organ procurement referrals. I also teach MATH 1110 (College Algebra Recitation) at CU Denver.
